parameters.name: feature_x
parameters.description: Index of the first feature to use (X axis)

parameters.name: feature_y
parameters.description: Index of the second feature to use (Y axis)

parameters.name: kernel
parameters.description: Kernel function that maps inputs to a higher-dimensional space. Linear works for linearly separable data; RBF and polynomial can fit non-linear boundaries.

parameters.name: C
parameters.description: Regularization parameter. Lower values widen the margin by allowing more misclassifications (soft margin); higher values enforce correct classification more strictly.

parameters.name: gamma
parameters.description: Kernel coefficient for RBF and polynomial kernels. Higher values make the decision boundary more sensitive to individual training points.

parameters.name: degree
parameters.description: Degree of the polynomial kernel. Only used when kernel is set to 'poly'.
